'''2013 SoCal Grand Prix''' was a Players Committee constructed tournament in San Diego, California, played 25–27 October 2013 in the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]).<ref name="tdl">https://www.starwarsccg.org/resources/tournament-decklists/</ref> [[Kevin Shannon]] won, defeating [[Matthew Harrison-Trainor]] in the final.<ref name="forum">https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=52931. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261022020944/https://swccg.com/snapshots/forum/t52931.html Internet Archive]</ref> Day 2 was the Top 4: Shannon, Harrison-Trainor, [[Reid Smith]] and [[Clayton Atkin]]. The Players Committee published the Day 1 and Day 2 decklists.<ref name="tdl" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' San Diego, California
* '''Dates:''' 25–27 October 2013
* '''Winner:''' [[Kevin Shannon]]
